investor.preheader: What happens next, and the annual offer.
investor.headline: Your trial ends in 3 days
body: Your free trial ends in 3 days. Nothing renews and you will not be charged. Your account moves to Free.

body.text: If TrueCap is earning its place, Pro annual is 50% off for your first year until {{offer_ends}}. The discount is applied at checkout when you choose Pro annual.
If TrueCap is earning its place, Pro keeps the Offer Ceiling, downside testing, comparisons, and reports on every deal.
